title: DIVINE
REFUGE
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: golden light rays through forest canopy
shadowed path leading to high mountain

scenes.a: If you are feeling surrounded by the weight of silence in this empty room, stay.
We seek the shadow of your wings to find our place of safety and strength.
But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
Lord, defend every heart that trusts in your holy name tonight as we rest.
Keep our minds anchored in your peace, shielded from every doubt that seeks entry.
Grant us the quiet confidence that only comes from knowing we dwell under you.
